question: Should modular dashboard workspace tabs get a dashboard-specific path-segment URL contract now, and should the generic `/plugin?plugin=...&id=...` route remain the compatibility path for other plugin tabs?
rationale: This is a user-visible web routing contract for an unmerged dashboard product stack, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent URL shape or compatibility behavior.

options.title: Route With Workspaces Stack
options.body: Add the dashboard path-segment route in the Workspaces PR or a narrow follow-up after maintainers accept the dashboard stack, while preserving the generic plugin-tab route.

options.title: Keep Query Routing For Now
options.body: Leave Workspaces on `?ws=` until the dashboard architecture and plugin-tab compatibility policy are accepted.

options.title: Defer To Roadmap
options.body: Keep this as a roadmap leaf if maintainers are not ready to sponsor bundled dashboard routing work.

recommendation.title: Route With Workspaces Stack
recommendation.body: Add the dashboard path-segment route in the Workspaces PR or a narrow follow-up after maintainers accept the dashboard stack, while preserving the generic plugin-tab route.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history signal for the plugin-tab route contract and recent Control UI route surface.
